brahman.en: Brahman, the one supreme reality behind all that is
brahman.hi: ब्रह्म, सबके मूलमें रहनेवाला एक परम सत्य

cosmos.en: the whole universe, as one ordered whole

covet.en: to long for what belongs to another

delusion.en: a false belief; a clouded, confused mind

demonic.en: of the demons (asuras); dark and evil

deva.en: a god, a shining one; in the Upaniṣads also the senses

karma.en: action, work; also its fruit, which binds the one who acts
karma.hi: कर्म; और उसका फल, जो करनेवालेको बाँधता है

mātariśvā.en: Mātariśvā, the wind; the life-breath of the cosmos

prajāpati.en: Prajāpati, lord of creatures, the creator

pūṣan.en: Pūṣan, the Sun as nourisher of all

renounce.en: to give up, to let go of

salutation.en: a bow or greeting of respect

seer.en: one who sees; a sage who sees the truth

sinew.en: a cord of the body that joins muscle to bone; a vein or a nerve

unmanifest.en: not seen or shown; not yet given form

yama.en: Yama, the controller; also the god of death
